programme.title: 超級三等兵
programme.desc: 部隊派來了新的輔導官包勝男來督察軍紀，眾兵發現原來派來的長官是個女的，操得眾兵痛不欲生，眾兵推派班長阿憲去把勝男泡到手，解救眾生一連串的泡妞行動卻徒勞無功反而被整蠱一番，阿憲於是逃亡了狗蛋，醜妹與阿憲班長在廢墟不期而遇，剛好又碰上不法的走私集團正在交易，陰差陽錯狗蛋及阿憲抓住了犯罪份子，立了大功狗蛋在學校頓時成了英雄人物，終於得到了小翠芳心，阿憲班長也立了大功接受上級表揚，海防部隊又恢復了往日的悠哉

programme.title: 車手
programme.desc: 隱形車隊是香港交通警隊的精英小組，擁有技術高超的隊員駕駛偽裝的警車，沿街巡察追緝目標而其中滿腔熱血的隊員阿翔（余文樂 飾），與他的搭檔電腦偵測員盧峰（黃秋生 飾）互不對盤，經常因為失和而導致任務失敗 而後，阿翔在執勤中碰上黑道傳奇車手蔣薪，沒想到居然毫不費勁將蔣薪緝拿歸案，此事讓盧峰察覺另有內情，原來蔣薪是故意落網，並在入獄後救出友人，逃之夭夭 隱形車隊緊急派出所有精英駕駛追捕，但最後還是讓他揚長離去此時阿翔才發現長久以來的夥伴盧峰，與蔣薪之間竟有一段不為人知的過去...

programme.title: 特工爺爺
programme.desc: 患有健忘症的退休特工老丁（洪金寶 飾），因意外不幸與孫女走散，飽受家人呵責後再無來往他回到老家小鎮，過著孤獨的生活，幸而遇上鄰家小女孩春花，一老一少慢慢成了忘年之交可惜好景不常，女孩父親（劉德華飾）無意間捲入了中俄幫派大仇殺，令春花身陷險境老特工看不過眼，隻身前去營救春花面對這場牽涉各幫派重大利益的混戰中，外表看似孱弱不堪的老丁，竟然施展出匪夷所思的格鬥技能，最後，他能否擊退黑幫，勇救春花？

programme.title: 烈火戰車2極速傳說
programme.desc: 一個生於富裕之家的年青人，駕著他心愛的坐駕Rx-7跑車他身邊吸引著一群喜愛追求速度刺激的年青人跟隨，當中尤以在Sky車房工作的趴地熊和謝賢為最，趴地熊生性戇直，而謝賢則貪財貪玩，二人雖目的不同，卻皆視Sky為偶像，但在Sky的眼中，除了愛車Rx-7和他的女朋友阿希外，其餘的人全不放在眼內生日當夜，另一派人馬喪偈要和Sky在速度上一決勝負，Sky談笑接戰，展開了一場又一場公路上的生死時速房車賽

programme.desc: 現代女子兼古董店的繼承人洛晴川，在訂婚儀式上為了追一幅被風吹走的清裝美人圖而跑至一處神秘樹林中美人圖到手的一剎那卻腳下一空，跌入時空隧道並穿越到清朝康熙四十七年（即1708年），偶遇身在高位卻每日戰戰兢兢怕從高位上跌下來的太子胤礽，玩世不恭愛闖禍的八阿哥胤?，還有喜怒無常不相信任何人的四阿哥胤禛

programme.title: 青面修羅
programme.desc: 因一塊藏寶銅片慘遭滅門的青面修羅齊君元在神秘刺客組織離恨谷長大，某日離恨谷受託奪取藏寶銅片，谷主卻不派齊君元追查，他決意復仇，不惜叛谷暗中調查血案消失多年的銅片為何再現？面對各路高手追殺捲入兩國鬥爭，齊君元更發現自己身陷一個局，設局者是何方神聖？神秘委託人是何許人也？

programme.title: 大稻埕
programme.desc: 大學生陳佑熙，是個有點小憂鬱，沒有太大人生目標的大學生，失戀之後，萬念俱灰誰知在有點古怪的歷史系朱正德教授的引導下，佑熙竟然陰錯陽差地掉入時光隧道，回到大稻埕1920年代日治時期台灣最繁華的第一鬧區，還遇到朱教授

programme.title: 殭屍先生
programme.desc: 茅山師父九叔受委託為任老爺起棺遷葬，惟任老爺之屍體屍變，變成殭屍，並四處為害此時，九叔的兩名徒弟文才及秋生亦分別因女友婷婷而被殭屍所傷，以及受女鬼小玉所迷惑九叔如何同時面對徒弟們生死存亡，以及殭屍為害的問題呢？

programme.title: 唐人街探案
programme.desc: 本該是一趟完美泰國行，卻變成殺人行不行少年秦風警校落榜，包袱款款，要去海外散散心，並找了號稱唐人街第一神探的表舅唐仁來做陪一晚上花天酒地，才睜開眼睛，卻是哀天叫地，一樁離奇謀殺，唐仁被指為兇手，鐵血警探拘捕在即，更有兩光匪幫追殺在後，連唐人街教父都來湊一腳，他們要如何在時限內找出真相？多路人馬連環套，荒誕骨牌效應一連串，最不正經，地動天驚，恐怖殺人，笑能死人

programme.title: 劇場版派遣女醫 X Final
programme.desc: 當今的日本，白色巨塔已然崩壞，本該是拯救生命的醫療體制，也被迫迎來弱肉強食的時代在陷入危機的日本醫療現場，一群獨來獨往的自由醫生出現了，他們就像獨行俠般，不受體制牽絆，一如這位美麗性感的天才外科醫生大門未知子（米倉涼子飾演），她討厭成群結黨討厭權威討厭束縛，專業醫師執照與扎實養成的醫術，是她的唯一武器 這回，大門為了拯救某國總統的生命而離開日本...

programme.title: 天降神機
programme.desc: 黃星徹，18歲，幼時跟隨祖父母住在沿海一帶，直到國中才搬回與父母同住，期待著一個陌生又溫馨的家庭關係，然而好景不常，家中因父親賭債開始四處躲藏，母親也在償還債務後毅然決然離去，阿徹看在眼裡對母親沒有怨恨反倒徒留不捨，然而對以酒洗面的父親極度埋怨，兩人相處充滿在仇恨與怨懟之中，因父親在工地打臨時工與警察二叔的投靠，阿徹也在不停轉換學校與環境的過程，養成自力更生的能力，但一切轉換的不適與父親的關係等無處發洩，藉由打架與不良學生的標籤得以找到暫時的存在感

programme.title: 哪吒之魔童降世
programme.desc: 元始天尊將混元珠提煉成靈珠和魔丸，本應是靈珠轉世的哪吒因為太乙真人的失誤被魔丸托生，生來便註定是混世魔王在太乙真人的幫助下，希望哪吒可以學習本領，為民除害期間，哪吒認識了龍王之子敖丙，成為了彼此各自唯一的朋友然而面對人們的誤解和天雷的降臨，哪吒是否命中注定會立地成魔？他將何去何從？

programme.title: 殭屍叔叔
programme.desc: 偏僻山間，一僧一道比鄰而居和尚隨和開朗，更有一女徒菁菁玲瓏可愛；道士古板嚴厲，而徒弟嘉樂卻鬼馬頑皮性格不同的兩個師傅口角不斷，大斗其法，兩個冤家徒弟也搞笑連連，笑料頻出某天，一支奇異的喪葬隊伍路過此地，某邊疆皇族中屍毒死去，幻化成殭屍，千鶴道長及王子護送棺木上京途中遭遇暴雨，棺木被雷劈開，殭屍破棺而出，大開殺戒烏侍郎攜王子僥倖逃命，但王子已中屍毒和尚與道士命徒兒照看王子，兩人則衝入樹林尋找千鶴道長

programme.title: 錦衣衛-修羅戰場
programme.desc: 明朝天啟七年，北鎮撫司錦衣衛沈煉（張震 飾）在一次掃除亂黨任務中，為救畫師北齋（楊冪 飾），失手將同僚淩雲鎧（武強 飾）殺害此後便將自己陷入無盡深淵，一方面要應付來自陸文昭（張譯 飾）裴綸（雷佳音 飾）輪番質疑與調查，另一方面還被神秘女子要脅要放火燒了錦衣衛經歷司，並助她暗中挖掘醜陋的真相

programme.title: 目中無人-以眼還眼
programme.desc: 成瞎子是幽州特立獨行的捉刀人，手中的盲杖暗藏刀劍，憑聽風辨位之能分筋錯骨之技，孤獨地行走於江湖之中一日，流浪於幽州城內的小漁姐弟受到惡少李九郎的追殺，弟弟小草不幸身亡，倖存下來的小漁一心想要復仇，便賴上了武藝高強的成瞎子

programme.title: 紙人回魂
programme.desc: 陸小笙是消閒報的民俗記者，為了查清真相，去找紙紮舖老闆南裳打聽一樁奇聞異事據說那是二十年前，百貴鎮喬府小姐喬媛媛枉死，喬管家請紙札匠劉三為喬媛媛做了紙人陪葬劉三給紙人點了眼睛，喬媛媛借紙人回魂殺了喬老爺...

programme.title: 長歌行:30
programme.desc: 原是永寧郡主的李長歌因玄武門之變父喪母亡，她僥倖逃出城，赴幽州求援；途中，偶遇化名秦准的草原部落特勤阿詩勒隼，兩人不打不相識，漸生英雄相惜之感長歌在幽州粉碎一場陰謀，但郡主的身份卻敗露，前往?州避禍長歌藏於?州太守公孫恆身邊，助其共抗草原勢力侵襲，卻未想到敵方將領阿詩勒隼竟是自己的舊識秦准

programme.title: 小子
programme.desc: 沈迷於AR電玩小子的張融（陳昊森 飾），他在電玩世界風光登頂，現實生活卻一塌糊塗，女友芽芽（李霈瑜 飾）看不下去氣跑，又有黑道兄弟追著要錢，有天兩位身分不明的萌娃（吳宗修釋小願 飾）突然走進他的世界，更驚訝的是兩位萌娃居然有著異於正常小孩的強大武功，他以為幫助兩位萌娃回家就能擺脫麻煩，孰不知自己正捲入一場更大的危機

programme.title: 飆風老爹
programme.desc: 徐大偉是個技術高超的潛水教練，擇善固執讓他頗受業界好評，海派豪爽的個性，更是朋友的好酒友，但另一方面個性偏執頑固，一板一眼的個性，讓自己跟女兒若雲的關係一直不是處的很好，對若雲來說，父親就是個不負責任的糟老頭，在妻子過世後，兩人的關係更為惡劣 若雲也在高中畢業後，與男友仁勇負氣私奔到台北，十八年來，兩父女誰也不跟誰聯絡，始終僵在那裏，其實都在期待著誰先妥協，十八年後，仁勇在國外出差受傷，若雲緊急出國照顧，只好委託好友芳慧，帶著三個孩子回到墾丁讓大偉照顧，這舉動更讓大偉感到厭惡，十八年來無聲無息，突然就多了三個孫子，還要照顧他們，一向我行我素的大偉，一口氣多了三個家人，這讓他不知道該喜還是該怒！在一次與不良飆車族的衝突下，大家才發現，原來大偉就是傳說中的飆風騎士..

programme.title: 超級學校霸王
programme.desc: 劇情描述西元2043年，超級犯罪家將軍被捕，由於未來員警戒守森嚴，其手下於是穿越時光隧道來到50年前的香港，意欲改變歷史香港政府見事態嚴重，急派飛龍特警（劉德華等人）回到1993年的香港，保護50年前余鐵雄法官

programme.title: 殭屍叔叔
programme.desc: 偏僻山間，一僧一道比鄰而居和尚隨和開朗，更有一女徒菁菁玲瓏可愛；道士古板嚴厲，而徒弟嘉樂卻鬼馬頑皮性格不同的兩個師傅口角不斷，大斗其法，兩個冤家徒弟也搞笑連連，笑料頻出某天，一支奇異的喪葬隊伍路過此地，某邊疆皇族中屍毒死去，幻化成殭屍，千鶴道長及王子護送棺木上京途中遭遇暴雨，棺木被雷劈開，殭屍破棺而出，大開殺戒烏侍郎攜王子僥倖逃命，但王子已中屍毒和尚與道士命徒兒照看王子，兩人則衝入樹林尋找千鶴道長

programme.title: 黑白森林
programme.desc: 黃薑與七喜同為警察，但二人卻執法方式卻南轅北轍黃薑是剛正不阿的警察而七喜和黑幫老大盲超竟是結義兄弟致力打擊罪犯的黃薑佈下天羅地網，誓要將盲超繩之於法七喜知情後，前往通風報信，帶盲超走避，卻不幸遇上黃薑埋伏

programme.title: 行運超人
programme.desc: 葉孤紅（楊千嬅）自小霉運不斷，為了改運，她找上香港著名風水師賴料布（梁朝偉）料布與孤紅兩人投緣，但賴家確有祖宗遺訓禁止與葉姓人士接近，令料布不敢與孤紅更近一步經過孤紅的努力，料布終於決心突破心防接受孤紅此時料布發現原來孤紅的霉運是玄學高手斷蟹（鄭中基）的從中作梗

programme.title: 碧血劍:24
programme.desc: 夏雪宜?綽號金蛇郎君，全家被溫家堡之惡人慘殺，誓要報仇遇上溫儀後被儀的純真與善良打動，結成愛侶可惜溫儀被溫家堡利用，令雪宜身中劇毒及被挑斷手筋腳筋，儀欲將溫家惡行公開而遭活埋井下亡在生死關頭，雪宜被何紅藥救走並逼婚，結果被打斷雙腳，秘密囚於五毒教的靈蛇洞內 袁承誌?袁崇煥之子，立誌長大後保衛國家父被曹化淳誣害慘死，並誅連九族，承誌被夏雪宜所救，隨後在華山學藝，誓報父仇

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳:45
programme.desc: 南宋時期，慘遭滅門橫禍的郭靖楊康分別在江南七怪與全真教道士丘處機的教養下成人18年後，郭靖奉師命南下楊康卻貪戀富貴，認賊作父郭靖與黃蓉一見如故，彼此傾心，但因華箏之婚約在先，以及江南七怪的反對等多種因素，兩人情感可謂一波三折五位師父被害於桃花島，郭靖憤而離開黃蓉這一對兩情相悅的青年，經歷了坎坷磨難，才修成正果

programme.title: 另一種注目
programme.desc: 另一種注目是一個具文化精神的紀實節目，從各種人物故事切入，以嶄新的視野與獨特的觀點，探索台灣社會文化的現象與脈絡，為這個時代留下紀錄

programme.title: 風味轉身
programme.desc: 有故事的台灣物產有故事的台灣農漁人，以及熱愛土地的知名料理人，共同挑戰一場風味轉身的旅程節目走訪台灣山林與海洋，從產地到餐桌，帶領觀眾探索台灣物產的前世今生，深入農漁現場，貼近生產者的日常與堅持，聆聽土地孕育出的動人故事每一集將同時邀請知名主廚以獨特的料理視角重新詮釋在地食材，將產地面臨的挑戰化為創新的風味，讓每一道料理不只是美味，更承載土地人情與永續的價值，完成一場從產地到餐桌的精彩風味轉身

programme.title: 戇夫成龍:5
programme.desc: 事情緣起於傻仔丁常旺，旺本是豪門富商包慶豐九代單傳的獨子，旺母本是包老爺的妾侍，因原配夫人妒忌，誣捏旺母與家樸有染，包老爺盛怒之下，視有了身孕的旺母是懷有孽種，把旺母逐出家門，旺母流落異鄉並誕下旺，兩母子過了二十幾年相依為命的艱苦生活而包老爺二十多年來仍無子嗣，直至原配夫人患病去迦後，包老爺有感膝下無子承繼家產，遂派親侄包大業往尋旺兩母子，知不尋獲，包老爺寧願臨老續娶求子，也不會把家業傳給親侄大業一直欲承繼包老爺家產，如今希望幻滅，遂起歪心，在尋到旺兩母子時，暗中加害之，旺母死，旺被打傷後腦滾下山崖業以為旺已死，即找來一個身份卑賤的孤兒，頂包假冒包老爺之子，改名為包繼宗大業並編造故事，令繼宗亦以為自己就是流落在外的包家少爺

programme.title: 他來自江湖:30
programme.desc: 反映現今社會，無論富或貧皆有誤入歧途的人，但祇要決心洗心革面，改邪歸正，社會必定會接納他們反之，那些死不悔改，繼續為非作歹的人，最終必會受到法律制裁，並且落得慘淡收場明天（萬梓良）原是黑道英雄，後因一次買賣中，未婚妻（楊寶玲）意外身亡，大受打擊之餘，決洗心革面，經營聯誼會為生明天與母親（李香琴），舅父何英彪（吳孟達）及表弟向鑫淼（周星馳）同住，彪一直懷疑天是當年導致他被革離警隊的人，故對他諸多單打

programme.title: 十月初五的月光

programme.title: 金宵大廈
programme.desc: 蕭偉明（陳山聰飾）來到殘舊且品流複雜的金宵大廈當看更，遇上這裡的空姐住客Alex（李施嬅飾）容貌竟與夢中一直纏繞自己的旗袍女子相同！阿蕭接近Alex，瞭解更多彼此的關聯其間金宵大廈怪事不斷，不停上演著其他住客的人生及奇幻故事；阿蕭更發現Alex竟是一個殘影！

programme.title: 震震有詞
programme.desc: 很多人都說法律只保護懂法律的人，但法律其實不難懂，它甚至和你我的生活息息相關，無論是租屋購物婚姻家庭旅行等都可能扯上法律；一般人遇到了總是慌了手腳，不知如何處理甚至抱持著鴕鳥心態選擇置之不理，最後有可能造成更加難以收拾的局面！節目特別以專業律師團及藝人的精彩案例為主軸，透過他們親身經歷的真實故事，帶出一般民眾常見的法律困擾，讓觀眾在輕鬆的氛圍中了解及面對生活周遭的法律問題懂得保護自己，不再害怕法律

programme.title: Kulepas Dengan Ikhlas

programme.title: Oh My English! Road to Jogja

programme.title: Sedapnya Mulut
programme.desc: Bersama Sherry Al-Hadad, Doughlas Lim, Joanne Kam, Rizal Van Geyzel dan ramai lagi barisan pelawak stand-up, saksikan lawak panas mereka yang pasti menggeletek hati anda.

programme.title: Tentang Kopi
programme.desc: Panduan penyediaan kopi dan merasai kenikmati pelbagai rasa kopi tersebut.

programme.title: Kami Geng FIT
programme.desc: Program gaya hidup sihat dengan menunjukkan rutin senaman terbaik yang boleh digunakan dalam jadual sibuk harian masa kini.

programme.title: Cerita Artis Malaysia
programme.desc: Ikuti kisah eksklusif cerita mengenai kehidupan, kerjaya, dan pengalaman penggiat seni tanah air sepanjang mereka bergelar anak seni.

programme.title: Carta 10

programme.title: Robozeta S1

programme.title: Makania S2
programme.desc: Naz dan Dian didedahkan dengan satu rahsia Pejabat Alien merupakan kilang memperhamba tukang masak. Percubaan mereka untuk melarikan diri gagal apabila panggilan Rasaro tak berjaya, lalu mereka ditangkap.

programme.title: Super Nabil
programme.desc: Kini Nabil merasakan dia mempunyai super power tetapi dituduh penipu oleh Budak Poser dan DGeng lalu Nabil berjanji untuk membuktikan kuasanya pada perlawanan kedua iaitu Galah Panjang.

programme.title: Lagu Kanak-Kanak Didi Friends S2

programme.title: Otai Can Do It!

programme.title: Kembara Chef Wan S2

programme.title: Cik Misi 123

programme.title: Konsert Kilauan Emas Selebriti

programme.title: Dato S

programme.title: The Making Of TERBANG

programme.desc: A swordsman is suspected of being the thief of a treasure sent to Emperor. Through his investigation, he is led on to the trail of the supernatural Bloody Parrot. Poisonous things happen including a demonic possession, witches casting poison spells and disgusting autopsies. Then a dead constable turns into a vampire!

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiaos fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: The Water Margin
programme.desc: This is a martial arts epic directed by Chang Cheh. In the Sung Dynasty, the government is run by corrupt officials, so Sung Jiang gathers 108 outlaws at Mount Liang and establishes a band of patriotic heroes to end the repression of brutal overlords.

programme.title: Masked Avengers
programme.desc: A mysterious new gang, the Masked Avengers, is slaughtering the martial worlds greatest heroes. To stop them, three fearless fighters must track down the gangs hidden lair in Jingyang Town and put an end to their reign of terror.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: Roving Swordsman
programme.desc: An ambitious evil clan intends to rule the martial arts world. To achieve their goal, they must first steal a secret martial arts manuscript depicting how firearms can be produced. However, a supremely intelligent swordsman Shen Sheng Yi is protecting the manuscript and remains one step ahead of the evil clan.

programme.title: Secret Service of the Imperial Court
programme.desc: Zhao Bu Fan is the sergeant of the governments secret police. Wang is a cruel and ruthless eunuch who takes over the Emperors ruling power and leads the team of secret agents. After witnessing the atrocities committed by Eunuch Wang, Sergeant Zhao decides to defect but ends up being hunted by his friends, comrades and even his father.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The Generals henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: Apartment for Ladies
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer comes to Hong Kong in search for her missing younger sister, who had arrived in Hong Kong to be discovered as a nightclub singer. She finds lodging at an apartment for women run by a man-hating landlady, Mrs Chan. However, Mrs Chan cannot confine the young ladies youthful vitality within the apartment.

programme.title: The Magnificent Swordsman
programme.desc: The Magnificent Swordsman centres on the hero who vows vengeance against evil bandits who killed his family when he was a child. The hero recruits several friends to help the peasants rid their village of marauding bandits, the leader of the band being the man who killed his family.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: The Duel
programme.desc: After knowing his brother has killed the head of a rival triad, Jie takes the blame and was hunted by killers. With the help of Rambler Nan, Jie finally killed his enemies, but then found out that Nan is the one who has killed his father.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fte. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servants confusion, threatening the couples union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: The Killer Has No Return
programme.desc: Professional killer Lui goes to Malaysia after completing his mission of killing the big boss of a Hong Kong gang. His next target is a groom who is throwing his wedding banquet at a hotel in Chinatown. Just when Lui takes aim at his target, another victim instead of the groom is shot, and he becomes a scapegoat in this mystery assassination.

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Betty Ting plays Susan, a young woman hiding from her father by being a nightclub singer in Japan. Pop singer Chao Ke-jen Lin Chong gets permission from his boss to visit Japan, with the condition that he finds the bosss daughter. Boy finds girl, boy falls in love. But will the father approve?

programme.title: Shadow Girl
programme.desc: A young swordswoman becomes invisible during the day and a monster at night after taking her grandmas pill. She ruined the wedding of a bandit chiefs daughter using her powers and is hunted down by them for revenge. Will she escape the hunt?

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding each other and start to encounter bizarre adventures, before falling in love with each other.

programme.title: Dragon Swamp
programme.desc: Fan is cheated by her lover Tong to steal her masters Jade Dragon Sword. She is jailed in the Dragon Swamp as punishment and gave birth to a pair of twins - her daughter is raised by her master, while her son is taken by Tong. Twenty years later, the sword is stolen again and Fans daughter goes seeking for it, meeting Fans friend along the way.

programme.title: Dream of the Red Chamber 1961
programme.desc: Adapted from the most widely read and filmed novel in Chinese history, this version is said to be the most successful one. Betty Lohs looks, demeanour and aura in her portrayal of Lin Dai Yu has won her the epithet Classic Beauty.

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fangs fiance and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him...

programme.title: Six Assassins
programme.desc: Lord Li Ming is a feudal tyrant who oppresses the people, and even the Emperor who is his brother, cannot stop his evil act. Righteous swordsman Mu poses as Li Mings guard to plan for his assassination. He arrests six assassins who have tried to kill Li Ming, before making them his allies in a secret plot to kill him and end the tyranny.

programme.title: The Jade Faced Assassin
programme.desc: Two forbidden lovers, Zhang Zhen and Yue Nu, are killed by four villains and left behind their twin babies. Yue Nus elder sister hopes to restore the clans honour and separates the twins, arranging for them to be raised by competing clans. 18 years later, the twins meet and fight against each other, bringing chaos to the martial arts world.

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world.

programme.title: The Dragon Missile
programme.desc: Sima works for a corrupt lord Qin who is suffering from a deadly disease that only a special herb can cure. Qin sends him on an urgent mission to retrieve it, but the task is made more difficult when Sima has to fight off other martial artists who want to steal the cure away from him. He has to fight with his ultimate weapon, the Dragon Missile!

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: This joyous, raucous, colorful tunefest showcases the little seen dancing talents of celebrated kung-fu swordswoman Cheng Pei-Pei, as one of 3 girls dancing their way to the top.

programme.title: Hai Zhi Yao
programme.desc: CCTV brings you broadcasts of finely-produced artistic dramas that closely follow the pulse of the times.

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yips boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victims sister takes revenge by spiking the rapists drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The infamous Gang Trio is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million. When they discover the triad intends to seize the ransom and kill the child, they take the baby under their wing. Cornered by cops and hunted by gangsters, the three Rob-B-Hood must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Bandit Zhang Mu Zhi poses as a county chief and arrives in Goose Town hoping to make a fortune, only to encounter the ruthless and manipulative tycoon Huang Si Lang, who controls the town with fear and corruption. As the two powerful men clash, a thrilling battle of wits, deception, greed and gunfire erupts, throwing the entire town into chaos.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called Kung Fu Stuntmen. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husbands death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Lets Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewifes debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yis husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the Happy Spinsters Club set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tams life. Mas fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: The White Storm 2: Drug Lords
programme.desc: Drug lord Jizo joins forces with Mexican cartels, throwing Hong Kongs drug underworld into chaos. Determined to eradicate narcotics, billionaire Yu Shun Tin offers a HK100 million bounty on drug traffickers while concealing a dark bond with Jizo. As their shared past resurfaces, an explosive showdown becomes inevitable.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the others true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror her father is peeping at night and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: The Mad Monk 1993
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Jailed for accidental manslaughter, martial arts master Har Hao Mo discovers a killer targeting kung fu masters across Hong Kong. Determined to stop the murders, he helps police track down Fung Yu Sau, a ruthless fighter obsessed with proving his supremacy. As the killings continue, the two martial artists are drawn toward a deadly showdown.

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter the sole witness mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Caos enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Beis concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: The legendary swordsman Li, entrusts the Green Destiny sword to a noble house for safekeeping. It is swiftly stolen by Yu, a young aristocrat of immense martial skills trained by an unscrupulous outlaw master. Recognising her talent, Li tries to guide her towards righteousness but ultimately leads them both to a tragic fate.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: God of Gamblers 2
programme.desc: After the God of Gamblers Ko Chun disappears, his disciple Little Knife rises in the gambling world. His fame attracts a ruthless rival who seeks to defeat him. Facing high-stakes games, Little Knife must rely on his skills to overcome his enemies and defend the honour of the God of Gamblers.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kongs biggest stars

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move Invincible Wind and Fire Spin.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the worlds top stories as they happen.

programme.title: Travelogue
programme.desc: Travelogue is a 30-minute travel program. Through the journeys of our intrepid hosts, we experience the beauty, culture and mystery of China, discovering how people live in this vast country and showcasing Chinas transformation to the world.

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the worlds top stories as they happen.

programme.title: The Agenda
programme.desc: A weekly talk-show looking beyond the headlines and accepted wisdom to find the real story. Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, the Agenda quite simply sets the agenda.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City S1 - Yis LiLi-est Fan
programme.desc: While Everest is going through some typical teenager growing pains not wanting to brush his teeth or tidy his room, a welcome distraction comes in the form of LiLi, an adorable nine-year-old whos positively obsessed with Yi, Everest, and the crews pursuits. When Everest doesnt return from a sweets-filled outing with LiLi, the crew discovers LiLis intentions might not have been so pure.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Misconcepted Deceptions
programme.desc: Birch manages to convince Liam that Sandras grade-threatening bad mood stems from boy trouble. In an effort to get her out of her funk and into studying again, the cousins invent a secret admirer for Sandra. They soon find Sandras constant need for affirmation exhausting a further complication in their attempt to keep up their group grade point average.

programme.desc: 第十九集n韓烽假扮彪子與阿蛇孟先生交易，齊思哲識破電話中的毒師是假貨，專案組決定放長線另一邊王波逃亡時引爆炸彈，祝青越重傷昏迷，他本人被捕並供出多宗滅口案阿蛇隨後遭殺，屍體特徵與氫氟酸暴露將線索指向馮正西的玻璃廠王波坦承阿蛇想繞過馮正西聯絡諾沙；警方突襲制毒窩點，馮正西逃脫，地下實驗室卻被發現.

programme.title: 蓝朋友．旅朋友 温哥华篇 Cho Lam His Trip Buddies
programme.desc: 王祖蓝一条麻甩到东莞汕头之后，延续系列的真实风格再拍摄旅游节目不过，这趟旅途上会多了一些朋友同行，主轴更是要沿着祖蓝生命中的里程坐标，开展连场深度回访，发掘市井生活中的趣味与温情这次取景版图横跨福州广西温哥华，三个极具特色的地方，都在祖蓝不同的人生阶段留下了重大意义祖蓝分别与三组旅朋友走过街巷，从故乡情缘到文化启蒙，再往最重要的爱情归宿，以旅程片段诉说属于王祖蓝独一无二的故事.

programme.title: 美食新闻报道 Gourmet Express
programme.desc: 香港汇聚环球美食，特色佳肴贴地料理受到识饮识食之人的密切关注！黄婉曼蔡雪莹倪嘉雯黄嘉雯廖慧仪伍倩彤等美食主播主持，紧贴最新饮食情报与优惠，深入了解滋味背后的故事从不同平台网罗超人气食店的情报，主持亲自出动排队试食，带来真实食评不设堂食的外卖小店亦深受追捧，有何必吃之选？经营食店难免尝尽甜酸苦辣，摄制队追踪主理人忙碌的一天，从搜购食材准备材料到开档做生意，揭开故事味缘.

programme.title: 见步行步 台湾篇 I Go To Taiwan On Foot
programme.desc: 第4集n把彼此纹在身上n焯日景行遇到好心人引领到背包旅馆，以打工换宿，终解决住宿问题nn稍作安顿，二人到大街接受新任务，要用身上一件物品与途人交换，限时内换到较大的东西为胜焯日却假公济私，向女生索取社群账号？为赚取额外旅费，他们甘愿同时受罚，把对方头像纹上手背nn大吃一顿后，主持们转战特色酒吧，更于驻场歌手结他伴奏下合唱国境之南徇众要求再献一曲，景行要选唱英文版生日歌，场内却没有寿星，如何摆脱尴尬局面？.

programme.title: 兄弟帮 Big Boys Club
programme.desc: 兄弟帮是由一班好兄弟林盛斌梁竞徽王梓轩范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话流行文化潮流玩意等多元化内容有关爱情两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾谈情说爱，探讨两性相处之道异度空间专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼UFO奇人奇事等刺激话题.

programme.title: 天龙八部 Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021
programme.desc: 金庸先生為大家創造了一個波瀾壯闊的武俠世界，天龍八部更是金庸小說系列中最受讀者喜愛及追捧的巔峰之作之一，它的經典程度不言而喻，也是長盛不衰的改編題材nn故事以北宋哲宗時代為背景，通過丐幫幫主喬峰楊祐寧飾大理世子段譽白澍飾少林小僧虛竹張天陽飾三人的江湖歷險與愛恨情仇，以及圍繞在他們周圍的一眾江湖人物，展現了紛繁複雜的武林恩怨和無計可消除的貪嗔癡怨，勾勒了一幅充滿人情世態的生活畫卷，亦象征大千世界的芸芸眾生，皆逃不出情這一字帶來的痛苦糾纏.

programme.title: 六点半新闻报导 世界观 今日知多D News At 18:30 Global View Whats On Today
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报导本地两岸及国际重要新闻.

programme.title: 东张西望 Scoop 2026
programme.desc: 东张西望星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮今日突发环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家.

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里吴若希饰独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯李茵彤饰，控制欲极强万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰车婉婉饰半生相夫教子，忽然觉醒，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中当年嘉冰曾因万里坚持未婚生下女儿，母女彻底闹僵，如今嘉冰却突然无预警杀入及扰乱万里的生活万里力图维持秩序，唐芯则周旋两人之间，三代同堂火花四溅，矛盾不断职场上，富二代老板空降营销大神杨帆赵浚承饰，与万里平起平坐正面交锋，万里事业与家庭同时迎来危机.

programme.title: 死有对证 Cause Of Death
programme.desc: 新任女法醫程芷昕陳曉華飾從小受林琛韋家雄飾啟發，立志加入法醫科，入職後卻被上司林琛投閒置散林琛與身為重案組高級督察的前妻高淑嫻王綺琴飾水火不容，兩人因女兒林雪蕾離家出走而再次交集芷昕憑藉認真的工作態度贏得林琛認同，並與警員高俊馬貫東飾結緣，三人漸成默契十足的辦案鐵三角芷昕閨密單佩嘉吳若希飾經歷失戀失業打擊後轉任港聞記者，跟資深記者詹柏宇阮浩棕飾從歡喜冤家發展成互相扶持的夥伴正當芷昕事業步入正軌，卻聞好友佩嘉死訊，誓要還原真相，為逝者發聲！.

programme.title: 剥茧 The Truth Within
programme.desc: 第二十集n玻璃廠制毒筆記的字跡竟與導師吳永昌批改齊思哲論文的筆跡一致，而李明留下的解剖學書中還藏有關鍵分子式吳永昌辯稱只為患憂鬱症的妻子研藥，卻與妻子一同失蹤，警方判斷遭馮正西綁架齊思哲以公開制毒筆記誘敵，收到以老師換配方的威脅後隻身赴約，遭拆除定位器並押往工廠；韓烽追查接頭人阿森，槍戰後將其逮捕.

programme.title: 医生，你有病？ Who Heals the Healers?
programme.desc: 你有病这三个字，医生说过无数次，但甚少听人对自己讲新闻部方东升团队再次出动，依然在寻人，寻找最不像病人的病人--医生他们平时处事快狠准，见惯生死，但当角色互换，成为病榻上的患者或照顾者，同样会逃避与焦虑大众眼中的神，终究是普通人，救人的医生如何自救？全新节目医生，你有病？，翻开医生那本难念的经，细看他们的脆弱与挣扎，还原白袍背后最真实的血肉人生.

programme.title: 娱乐头条 EXTRA
programme.desc: 每晚紧贴香港娱乐圈的消息，以至世界各地的影视娱乐新闻，报导艺人最新动态剧集和电影宣传演唱会精华颁奖礼盛况等，甚至远赴外地采访娱乐盛事追踪各地影星，专访观众熟悉的歌影视红人，让大家瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈的动态和最新消息.

programme.title: 晚间新闻 News Roundup
programme.desc: 报导香港两岸国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向.

programme.title: 逆天奇案2 Sinister Beings 2
programme.desc: O記幹探許浚森陳展鵬飾沈韋力黃智賢飾奉命調查跨國罪案期間，得悉殺虎案幕後黑手魏子樂張頴康飾落網前，曾將神秘訊息發送至暗網，並匯出巨額加密貨幣不久有神秘人策動恐襲，浚森與韋力縱於天才教授唐冠峰方力申飾協助下破案，卻驚覺子樂背後藏着更大陰謀！他們要竭力阻止子樂的同時，也遇到龍頭棍風暴空屋藏白骨重犯越獄等奇案，能否一一掃除險阻？工作上面對的危機升級，感情亦遇挑戰，浚森望跟前女友馬穎思林夏薇飾復合，但困難重重令二人關係出現變數.

programme.title: 大醬園 Dripping Sauce, The
programme.desc: 萬冠園是佛山醬油業百年老字號，大當家萬啟山吳岱融飾與夫人席德容龔慈恩飾堅持傳男不傳女，傳內不傳外的宗旨，可是一宗毒醬油事故，使他不得不答應讓夏小滿朱晨麗飾及葉細么龔嘉欣飾兩女子加入，與其子萬卓楓何廣沛飾成為同期學徒三人與醬園小師傅華歌吳業坤飾建立了複雜的四角關係，又間接揭發了萬家多個秘密，加上卓楓突然被擄走，人心惶惶醬園內，啟山幾個弟弟啟石鄭子誠飾啟川陳嘉輝飾及啟江徐榮飾醞釀分家，醬園外，專員高兆榮袁文傑飾也密謀奪取醬園財產，萬冠園百年基業隨時毀於一旦！.

programme.title: 食為奴 Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: 高天寶王祖藍自小吃盡珍饈百味，各種美食經他一嚐便知龍與鳳，但遭逢家道中落被迫與家僕李衛胡諾言流落街頭，以賣飽糊口，因美食令他結識了賣藝女子紀慕雪萬綺雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女廚神米小魚何雁詩等人，更因緣際會遇上微服出遊的四皇子胤禛黃智賢，二人氣味相投，被引進到宮內的御膳房當御廚，天寶遇上宿敵蔡鶴亭林盛斌，掀起連場龍爭虎鬥；但天寶萬料不到自己竟捲入由八皇子胤禩張繼聰策動的奪嫡之爭中，在劣勢下天寶成了胤禛的福將，連番替他反敗為勝，但一段意外的婚約卻令天寶由一人之下頓貶為喪家狗.

programme.title: 愛情食物鏈 Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: 從事食品供應的魯佳芳阮小儀樣子平凡，身材矮小，年過三十仍欠缺戀愛經驗，因一次苦瓜事件，幫助餐飲業才俊劉柏業陳智燊渡過難關，令這位高富帥欣賞到佳芳的內在美，並與她漸生情愫，佳芳的鄰居兼好友高貴芬高海寧對此無法釋懷，賣魚出身的貴芬樣貌身材皆屬女神級數，千方百計也未能令柏業過電，卻召來台灣擔仔麵繼承者洪鱻金剛的青睞，洪鱻為親近貴芬不惜自貶身價與佳芳她們同住劏房，貴芬得不到柏業唯有轉戰二叔劉利高鄭子誠，但後來柏業承受不了外界對女友佳芳的負評，二人關係亮起紅燈；當愛情再不是飲水飽，美醜優劣再無標準，男女同時成了獵人與獵物，血肉橫飛的戀愛激戰即將一發不可收拾.

programme.desc: 高天寶王祖藍自小吃盡珍饈百味，各種美食經他一嚐便知龍與鳳，但遭逢家道中落被迫與家僕李衛胡諾言流落街頭，以賣飽糊口，因美食令他結識了賣藝女子紀慕雪萬綺雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女廚神米小魚何雁詩等人，更因緣際會遇上微服出遊的四皇子胤禛黃智賢，二人氣味相投，被引進到宮內的御膳房當御廚，天寶遇上宿敵蔡鶴亭林盛斌，掀起連場龍爭虎鬥；但天寶萬料不到自己竟捲入由八皇子胤禩張繼聰策動的奪嫡之爭中，在劣勢下天寶成了胤禛的福將，連番替他反敗為勝，但一段意外的婚約卻令天寶由一人之下頓貶為喪家狗.

programme.title: 愛情食物鏈 Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: 從事食品供應的魯佳芳阮小儀樣子平凡，身材矮小，年過三十仍欠缺戀愛經驗，因一次苦瓜事件，幫助餐飲業才俊劉柏業陳智燊渡過難關，令這位高富帥欣賞到佳芳的內在美，並與她漸生情愫，佳芳的鄰居兼好友高貴芬高海寧對此無法釋懷，賣魚出身的貴芬樣貌身材皆屬女神級數，千方百計也未能令柏業過電，卻召來台灣擔仔麵繼承者洪鱻金剛的青睞，洪鱻為親近貴芬不惜自貶身價與佳芳她們同住劏房，貴芬得不到柏業唯有轉戰二叔劉利高鄭子誠，但後來柏業承受不了外界對女友佳芳的負評，二人關係亮起紅燈；當愛情再不是飲水飽，美醜優劣再無標準，男女同時成了獵人與獵物，血肉橫飛的戀愛激戰即將一發不可收拾.

programme.title: 逆天奇案2 Sinister Beings 2
programme.desc: O記幹探許浚森陳展鵬飾沈韋力黃智賢飾奉命調查跨國罪案期間，得悉殺虎案幕後黑手魏子樂張頴康飾落網前，曾將神秘訊息發送至暗網，並匯出巨額加密貨幣不久有神秘人策動恐襲，浚森與韋力縱於天才教授唐冠峰方力申飾協助下破案，卻驚覺子樂背後藏着更大陰謀！他們要竭力阻止子樂的同時，也遇到龍頭棍風暴空屋藏白骨重犯越獄等奇案，能否一一掃除險阻？工作上面對的危機升級，感情亦遇挑戰，浚森望跟前女友馬穎思林夏薇飾復合，但困難重重令二人關係出現變數.

programme.title: 爱情食物链 Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: 从事食品供应的鲁佳芳阮小仪样子平凡，身材矮小，年过三十仍欠缺恋爱经验，因一次苦瓜事件，帮助餐饮业才俊刘柏业陈智燊渡过难关，令这位高富帅欣赏到佳芳的内在美，并与她渐生情愫，佳芳的邻居兼好友高贵芬高海宁对此无法释怀，卖鱼出身的贵芬样貌身材皆属女神级数，千方百计也未能令柏业过电，却召来台湾担仔面继承者洪鱻金刚的青睐，洪鱻为亲近贵芬不惜自贬身价与佳芳她们同住劏房，贵芬得不到柏业唯有转战二叔刘利高郑子诚，但后来柏业承受不了外界对女友佳芳的负评，二人关系亮起红灯；当爱情再不是饮水饱，美丑优劣再无标准，男女同时成了猎人与猎物，血肉横飞的恋爱激战即将一发不可收拾.

programme.title: 大酱园 Dripping Sauce, The
programme.desc: 万冠园是佛山酱油业百年老字号，大当家万启山吴岱融饰与夫人席德容龚慈恩饰坚持传男不传女，传内不传外的宗旨，可是一宗毒酱油事故，使他不得不答应让夏小满朱晨丽饰及叶细么龚嘉欣饰两女子加入，与其子万卓枫何广沛饰成为同期学徒三人与酱园小师傅华歌吴业坤饰建立了复杂的四角关系，又间接揭发了万家多个秘密，加上卓枫突然被掳走，人心惶惶酱园内，启山几个弟弟启石郑子诚饰启川陈嘉辉饰及启江徐荣饰酝酿分家，酱园外，专员高兆荣袁文杰饰也密谋夺取酱园财产，万冠园百年基业随时毁于一旦！.

programme.desc: 七年前一宗严重车祸，破坏了两个家庭，改变了姜煜诚林文龙饰方乐汶黄翠如饰的人生七年后一次交通意外，让煜诚重遇乐汶，生活仍然有悲有喜乐汶与妹妹方书文连诗雅饰因身边人逐一离开而闹僵，没想到行为怪异的医生古希晨马贯东饰，却能直捣问题根源乐汶忙于照顾女儿朱幸而及继子朱嘉炳顾定轩饰，煜诚则一直未能了解独女姜子优苏皓儿饰的需要子优和嘉炳因缘走近，共同朋友莫宇谦李任燊饰竟为此段关系衍生更多问题，也令当年车祸真相渐渐浮现，众人亦要再次面临改变.

programme.title: 爱情食物链 Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: 从事食品供应的鲁佳芳阮小仪样子平凡，身材矮小，年过三十仍欠缺恋爱经验，因一次苦瓜事件，帮助餐饮业才俊刘柏业陈智燊渡过难关，令这位高富帅欣赏到佳芳的内在美，并与她渐生情愫，佳芳的邻居兼好友高贵芬高海宁对此无法释怀，卖鱼出身的贵芬样貌身材皆属女神级数，千方百计也未能令柏业过电，却召来台湾担仔面继承者洪鱻金刚的青睐，洪鱻为亲近贵芬不惜自贬身价与佳芳她们同住劏房，贵芬得不到柏业唯有转战二叔刘利高郑子诚，但后来柏业承受不了外界对女友佳芳的负评，二人关系亮起红灯；当爱情再不是饮水饱，美丑优劣再无标准，男女同时成了猎人与猎物，血肉横飞的恋爱激战即将一发不可收拾.

programme.title: 逆天奇案2 Sinister Beings 2
programme.desc: O记干探许浚森陈展鹏饰沈韦力黄智贤饰奉命调查跨国罪案期间，得悉杀虎案幕后黑手魏子乐张颕康饰落网前，曾将神秘讯息发送至暗网，并汇出巨额加密货币不久有神秘人策动恐袭，浚森与韦力纵于天才教授唐冠峰方力申饰协助下破案，却惊觉子乐背后藏着更大阴谋！他们要竭力阻止子乐的同时，也遇到龙头棍风暴空屋藏白骨重犯越狱等奇案，能否一一扫除险阻？工作上面对的危机升级，感情亦遇挑战，浚森望跟前女友马颖思林夏薇饰复合，但困难重重令二人关系出现变量.

programme.title: 巨轮 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 乔天生（陈展鹏饰）和罗威信（萧正楠饰）是同母异父的亲兄弟，因为命运令他们不单分开在香港和澳门两地，更令他们尝尽剧变历史中的两极冲突 母亲周玉梅（李司棋饰）带着小儿子威信在澳门当黑市居民，威信凭着努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮饰）与龙飞（阮兆祥饰）的相助，历尽艰辛，克服挑战，最终踏上成功之路独自在港自食其力的天生却改走快捷方式，联结黑道古惑仔姜勇（张继聪饰），与富家女发生关系，令女友卓静（钟嘉欣饰）伤心欲绝，最终落得人财两空 本是唇齿相依的手足情，经历时代巨轮的洗礼，前境变幻莫测，二人愈走愈远，但一个信念深植在他们相连的血脉里，纵然考验再苦再难，终在一条又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 他来自江湖 Justice Of Life, The
programme.desc: 明天原是黑道枭雄，因一次买卖令未婚妻意外身亡而大受打击，决洗心革面，经营联谊会为生明天与母亲舅父何英彪及表弟何鑫淼同住，英彪一直怀疑明天当年连累他被革离警队，故对他诸多单打，但明天并不介怀，鑫淼却视明天为偶像，两人情同手足，使英彪为之气结明天自未婚妻死后，本心如止水，不料邂逅余文骞及阮黛玉，感情生活泛起涟漪鑫淼为父误入歧途，牵涉入毒品买卖，明天为救鑫淼，联同警务督察旧友马世雄，与黑帮周旋.

programme.title: 使徒行者3 Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: 薛家强林峯饰完成三年卧底任务后，回港开设沐足店，继续收集情报刑事情报科总督察章纪孜黄智雯饰怀疑卓凯苗侨伟饰出狱后投入黑道，对他进行全面监视家强与卓凯卷入器官贩卖案，联同女卧底窦亚希蔡思贝饰及保安局调查官韦作荣马国明饰，合力捣破涉案集团保安局及后新设安全情报机构，并邀得徐天堂袁伟豪饰加入，接管刑事情报科的工作覃欢喜许绍雄饰逃过一死后，暗中调查某社团的秘密神秘社团原来由长兴已故龙头魏德信的弟弟魏德礼创立，他还设下布局，对家强卓凯等展开报复.

programme.title: 碧血盐枭 Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: 缉私营的聂致远马浚伟为剿灭盐枭窦家寨，故意扮作落难秀才博取盐枭之女窦胜雪杨怡的同情及收留，因而与窦胜雪建立了深厚的感情某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混乱之中窦胜雪身受重伤并与聂致远及家人失散，幸得盐商胡坚郭峰之子胡亭轩黄浩然相救，并暂留胡府待找回双亲及聂致远，但窦胜雪却惊见父母的尸首被悬于城楼示众，而站在楼顶大义凛然地告诫众人不要贩卖私盐的官员，竟是令自己日夜牵肠挂肚的聂致远，窦胜雪柔肠寸断，且对聂致远有彻骨之恨......胡亭轩为助窦胜雪忘却不快，安排她在胡府经营的盐栈工作，而窦胜雪为报答胡亭轩救命之恩，不计劳苦为盐栈出心出力，那段日子令胡亭轩对窦胜雪由怜生爱，却碍于恶疾缠身，一直未敢表白，直至窦胜雪的二叔突然现身，暴露了窦胜雪的真正身份，胡亭轩为防家人报官竟向窦胜雪提亲......

programme.title: 荷里活有个大老千 I Bet Your Pardon
programme.desc: 来自英国的保镖主管夏天行杨明，到港后奉命保护网络教主张非凡王浩信，顺道寻觅身世线索非凡行事张狂，还藉举办拳赛掩护窃密黑客赴港，期间屡遇险境麻烦，幸得天行一一化解事件引来火爆刑警何铁男伍允龙关注，决心全力追查原来铁男曾因一时冲动犯下不可告人的过失，性格亦渐走偏锋拳赛同时激发三人的好战天性，他们又逐渐发现彼此拥有相同的感应能力，藉以互助互救而三人背后的隐密连系，更牵涉逾二十年前的金融风暴之战.

programme.title: Janji Arissa
programme.desc: Arissa mengambil kesempatan kepada anak Muhammad, TJ untuk membuatkan Shahira berasa cemburu. Shariff berdepan dengan masalah judi dan meminta wang dengan Shida dengan alasan hendak memulakan perniagaan. Keadaan Siti semakin sakit dan akhirnya di bawa ke hospital oleh Kamini. Arissa juga merapatkan diri dengan Muhammad sehingga menyebabkan Shida berasa marah.

programme.title: Cinta Dalam Sekam
programme.desc: Keadaan Uwan yang semakin merosot akibat demensia menyebabkan dia merayau tanpa alas kaki pada waktu malam. Pada 1988, pilihan Laila semakin terbatas, manakala Amanda mengambil langkah berani. Ketegangan yang memuncak turut mengancam persahabatan Imran dan Shafiq.

programme.title: Cinta Dalam Sekam
programme.desc: Alia nekad membongkar kisah silam selepas Uwan mendedahkan satu kebenaran yang menyakitkan. Kembali ke 1988, Laila mengambil tindakan sendiri, sementara beberapa keputusan sukar menguji persahabatan Imran dan Shafiq.

programme.title: Cinta Dalam Sekam
programme.desc: Petunjuk baharu dalam pencarian Alia untuk menemukan Laila membawanya semakin hampir kepada kebenaran. Ketika kisah silam terbongkar, Shafiq berdepan persimpangan, manakala kehidupan dalam pelarian mendedahkan Imran dan Laila kepada niat tersembunyi serta bahaya baharu.

programme.title: Cinta Dalam Sekam
programme.desc: Alia mula mendapat kepercayaan seseorang yang mungkin memegang kunci kepada kisah silam Laila, sementara keadaan Uwan yang semakin merosot membuatkan keluarganya berada dalam kebimbangan. Harapan Imran dan Laila untuk memulakan hidup baharu turut terancam.

programme.title: Judika Live in Malaysia 2025 Part 1
programme.desc: Konsert Judika Live in Malaysia 2025 yang berlangsung pada 15 November 2025 di Stadium Hoki Nasional, Bukit Jalil, menyaksikan penyanyi terkenal Indonesia itu memukau ribuan peminat menerusi persembahan bertenaga selama hampir dua jam dengan menyanyikan lebih 20 lagu popular beliau.

programme.title: Celebs Day Off
programme.desc: Saksikan bagaimana seorang selebriti mengisi hari cuti mereka dengan bermacam aktiviti-aktiviti menarik. Dihoskan oleh Asmawi, anda akan mengenali lebih lanjut kisah kehidupan dan karier tetamu undangan kali ini, Azizul Ammar.

programme.title: Trendsetter
programme.desc: Trendsetter adalah rancangan mengenai trend fesyen dan gaya hidup. Kini kembali dalam musim terbaru bersama pengacara Zakuan Zainal. Episod kalini menampilkan Icon Luxe dalam segmen Usha Kedai, Gaya Kerjaya Pele L dan Bedah Kotak AApparel - Denim Jeans

programme.title: Concert Dia.. Lagenda Unplugged Fairuz Hussin
programme.desc: Dalam rancangan ini, Fairuz Hussin berkongsi pelbagai cerita permulaan penglibatannya di dalam dunia seni nyanyian.

programme.title: Judika Live in Malaysia 2025 Part 2
programme.desc: Konsert Judika Live in Malaysia 2025 yang berlangsung pada 15 November 2025 di Stadium Hoki Nasional, Bukit Jalil, menyaksikan penyanyi terkenal Indonesia itu memukau ribuan peminat menerusi persembahan bertenaga selama hampir dua jam dengan menyanyikan lebih 20 lagu popular beliau.

programme.title: Janji Arissa
programme.desc: Arissa mula mencari maklumat tentang AR Holdings. Fendi pula mula membuat video tentang produk AR Holdings yang memberi kesan negative kepada para pengguna. Siti mengalami kemalangan dan memerlukan darah. Muhammad yang masih belum mengetahui identiti ibu kepada Arissa menawarkan diri untuk menderma darah. Arissa melihat akan kebaikan Muhammad dan mula berubah fikiran terhadap Muhammad.

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Syarfan tidak bersetuju dengan cadangan Antasya dan menjelaskan niatnya. Syarfan terharu melihat Antasya yang sarat mengadug gigih membantu Talia yang semakin teruk keadaanya menguruskan diri. Alia enggan menjaga Talia. Nazarin menuduh Alia tidak professional dan tidak layak menjadi nurse.

programme.title: Cek Ombak
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Kika dan Igo, sepasang kekasih yang bertemu melalui aplikasi kencan, namun menghadapi komplikasi rumit ketika orang tua mereka menikah. Hubungan mereka diuji oleh ikatan persaudaraan tiri dan penolakan orang tua.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Tengku Maria menjadi semakin bimbang melihat keadaan Iskandar yang semakin tidak bermaya dan tidak terurus. Dia minta Haziq untuk kembali ke Kuala Lumpur dan menasihati Iskandar, namum Haziq enggan pulang selagi dia tidak dapat membawa Aisyah pulang bersama. Haziq juga masih terluka dengan ungkitan yang disebut oleh Iskandar tentang asal usulnya. Iskandar masih menanti dan sentiasa mencari Aisyahy, setiap malam dia bermimpi akan Aisyah yang datang menemuinya dan kembali semula ke kondo itu. Iskandar kesal, dia nekad untuk menebus segala khilafnya sekiranya Aisyah kembali kepadanya. Aisyah masih enggan pulang ke Kuala Lumpur, dia bertegas bahawa dia tidak mengenali Haziq dan sesiapa di Kuala Lumpur itu. Anim dan Azri cuba meyakinkan Aisyah namun sering kali gagal. Tanpa diduga, Rokiah dan Sarip berat hati untuk melepaskan Aisyah pergi. Di sebalik layanan baik Rokiah dan Sarip terhadap Aisyah, sebenarnya mereka pernah kehilangan anak perempuan mereka ketika berusia 6 tahun akibat kemalangan jalan raya. disebabkan itu mereka sangat menyanyangi Aisyah dan bersyukur ingatan Aisyah membolehkan Aisyah kembali kepada memori dia bersama arwah ibu dan ayahnya. Haziq mengambil keputusan untuk memberitahu hal itu kepada Tengku Maria, berita itu membuatkan Tengku Maria gembira dan tidak sabar untuk menyambut kepulangan Aisyah. Namun Haziq tidak memberitahu perihal ingatan Aisyah yang sudah hilang memorinya. Anim, Azri, Rokiah, Sarip dan Amani bersetuju untuk bersama membawa Aisyah ke Kuala Lumpur demi menjamin keselamatan Aisyah dan kejujuran Haziq yang mahu Aisyah pulang ke Kuala Lumpur.

Dan berita ini juga membuatkan Aisyah meroyan dan terus ke rumah Alawiyah untuk meyakinkan Alawiyah menerimanya sebagai menantu dan apabila Jazlan sampai dari Mesir Aisyah terus meluru masuk ke rumah Alawiyah dan sekali lagi meminta Alawiyah menerimanya sebagai menantu bukan Qasih. Jazlan pula teringat akan kata-kata Qasih semasa memarahi beliau kerana bersetuju untuk berkahwin dengannya lalu Jazlan terus memaklumkan kepada ibunya untuk membatalkan pernikahannya dengan Qasih

programme.desc: Demi ibunya, Rizrin berhijrah ke KL selepas melepaskan kekasihnya, Ariyana, kepada abangnya. programme.title: Jendela Hati
programme.desc: Mama sekali lagi diserang heart attack hingga terpaksa dibawa ke hospital. Farah makan hati melihat Lukman datang bersama Myra untuk melawat Mama. Famili Lukman juga terkejut dengan keberanian Lukman seolah-olah memberi isyarat bahawa hubungannya dengan Myra adalah serius

programme.title: Ia Wujud
programme.desc: Sekumpulan remaja menceroboh masuk ke sebuah taman tema yang telah lama ditinggalkan. Berlatarbelakangkan zaman sebelum tersebarnya kisah-kisah seram dari kes Highland Tower, kumpulan ini percaya bahawa hantu tidak wujud. Lalu mereka mencabar satu sama lain untuk bermain permainan roh duit syiling di dalam taman tema terbiar itu.

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu S2 EP2
programme.desc: Nadirah dan Farhan merupakan pasangan suami isteri yang sudah lama mendambakan cahaya mata. Antologi mengisahkan Lima pelajar universiti menemui Long Samad Que Haidar, penjaga sebuah rumah terpencil yang menceritakan kisah-kisah seram seantero nusantara.

programme.title: Jangan Pandang Belakang
programme.desc: Darma trauma dengan bunuh diri tunangnya, Rose, yang telah dihantui oleh makhluk halus jahat. Roh tersebut secara tidak sengaja dibebaskan oleh pasangan itu selepas mereka menemui sebuah balang kecil yang terdampar di pantai. Selepas kematian Rose, Darma membawa balang itu bersamanya, tanpa disedari telah membawa roh tersebut ke dalam hidupnya. Terkejut dengan kejadian bunuh diri itu, Darma bekerjasama dengan adik kembar Rose, Seri, untuk menyiasat. Semasa mereka menyiasat, pelbagai kejadian aneh berlaku, menyebabkan keadaan mental Darma semakin merosot dan memberi kesan kepada kerjayanya. Dia pulang ke kampung untuk berehat, tanpa disedari semakin hampir dengan kebenaran. Akhirnya, terungkap bahawa nenek Darma secara tidak sengaja telah mengundang roh yang dikenali sebagai Saka ke dalam rumah mereka, satu roh yang menghantui keturunan pemiliknya selepas kematian.

programme.title: Highland Tower
programme.desc: Pada Disember 1993, sebuah blok kondominium mewah runtuh selepas hakisan tanah dari lereng bukit bersebelahan. Kira-kira 50 orang terkorban dan kejadian ini sehingga kini menjadi salah satu tragedi paling gelap dan menyedihkan dalam sejarah Malaysia. Dua puluh tahun kemudian, pada 2013, sekumpulan pembuat filem dokumentari menjelajah ke dua blok yang masih berdiri untuk menjalankan ekspedisi memburu hantu. Apa yang mereka temui tidak sesuai untuk mereka yang lemah semangat.

Dalam keadaan kelam kabut itu, seorang demi seorang penerjun melompat keluar dan mendarat di sebuah kawasan hutan. Di sana, mereka diganggu pelbagai peristiwa dan menganggap tempat itu berpuaka. Kapal terbang yang mereka naiki terlanggar seekor burung helang dan mengakibatkan pesawat itu bergegar. Dalam keadaan kelam kabut itu, seorang demi seorang penerjun melompat keluar dan mendarat di sebuah kawasan hutan. Di sana, mereka diganggu pelbagai peristiwa dan menganggap tempat itu berpuaka. Namun, Kapten Hanafi mengesyaki semua peristiwa itu adalah berpunca daripada perbuatan manusia.

programme.title: Perjanjian Syaitan
programme.desc: Tambun membunuh Tok Kadim, penghulu di sebuah kampung dan kemudiannya mengatakan bahawa Tok Kadim mati satu kemalangan. Selepas kejadian itu, Tambun dilantik menjadi ketua kampung yang baharu. Pada masa yang sama, Ribut, adik kepada Tambun yang berwajah hodoh ingin membalas dendam kepada Ujang kerana menolak cintanya dan memilih Seri sebagai teman. Ribut bersahabat dengan syaitan yang berjanji untuk menjadikannya seorang perempuan cantik. Sejak itulah Ribut berusaha untuk membalas dendam sehingga berlaku beberapa siri kematian yang penuh misteri.

programme.title: Dendam Dari Pusara
programme.desc: Dolah, seorang buruh kasar yang cacat kaki sejak kecil mempunyai ilmu luar biasa yang diperolehinya dengan memotong dagu si mati dijadikan minyak tetapi perlu mematuhi syarat ketat dengan memulangkan barang-barang yang diperolehi dalam tempoh seribu hari. . Dolah melakukan kerja ngeri ini dengan bantuan dua orang kawannya, tetapi pada suatu masa dia telah gagal memenuhi syarat tersebut dan bermacam kejadian telah berlaku selepas itu.

programme.title: Sate
programme.desc: Milah ialah seorang peniaga sate dan kedai satenya terletak di hadapan bengkel kepunyaan Kadir yang suka melakukan eksperimen aneh. Kadir ingin menyertai Anugerah Saintis untuk memenangi hadiah utama dan sekaligus menyenangkan hidup Milah. Pelbagai rintangan terpaksa dia lalui untuk mencipta mesin miliknya dan akhirnya Kadir berjaya menyiapkan mesin tersebut dan menyertai pertandingan itu.

programme.title: Duhai Si Pari-Pari
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Syadon, seorang pemuda yang mencintai Mala. Pada suatu hari, Syadon bertemu seorang gadis bernama Pari yang sedang mencari kekasihnya. Semakin hari, Pari semakin suntuk waktu yang Pari ada untuk mengahwini jejaka idamannya dan pulang ke dunia kayangan. Syadon bertanya siapakah Pari yang sebenarnya dan setelah diterangkan, dia sukar mempercayainya. Pari terpaksa membuktikan kata-katanya dengan menunaikan permintaan Syadon.

programme.title: Putera
programme.desc: Putera Hussein, pewaris takhta kerajaan Nusantara yang tidak mahu dijodohkan dengan sepupunya, Puteri Balkis. Ayahanda Putera Hussein memberi tempoh selama 30 hari kepadanya untuk mencari bakal isteri. Putera Hussein menyamar sebagai rakyat biasa dan bertemu dengan seorang gadis bernama Noraini. Mereka berdua jatuh cinta namun percintaan itu mendapat halangan keluarga Noraini.

programme.title: Karipap-Karipap Cinta
programme.desc: Ali bekerja sebagai jurufoto di syarikat penerbitan majalah jatuh hati kepada Sarah, seorang lulusan Universiti Al-Azhar. Ali panik apabila rakan serumahnya memberitahu keluarga Sarah ingin menjodohkannya dengan seorang ustaz. Untuk memenangi hati Sarah dan keluarganya, Ali terpaksa berbohong dengan mengatakan dia juga merupakan seorang graduan Universiti Al-Azhar. Dalam masa yang sama bos Ali, Dato Razali Bunari cuba mendedahkan satu skandal yang turut melibatkan bapa Sarah.

programme.title: Seri Dewi Malam
programme.desc: Cinta seorang isteri kepada suami yang sangat kuat membuatkannya ingin terus berjuang untuk hidup. Azri menemui jalan untuk berkomunikasi bersama isterinya, Seri yang jatuh koma. Dewi, seorang gadis buta yang memboleh membaca minda memutuskan untuk membantu Azri berhubung dengan Seri. Lama kelamaan, perasaan cinta mula muncul dan Azri harus membuat pilihan yang sukar.

programme.title: Perempuan
programme.desc: Nita merancang untuk menikahi teman lelakinya, Idris. Berasal dari keluarga yang kaya, Nita merasakan ibunya bersikap seperti seorang majikan kerana kesibukan kedua orang tuanya. Nita menagih kasih sayang kedua ibu bapanya. Ingin bertunang dengan Idris namun ibunya ingin menjodohkan Nita bersama anak Datuk Hamzah.

programme.title: Soal Hati
programme.desc: Daniel ialah seorang lelaki playboy kaya yang mempunyai perniagaan yang berjaya. Dia mula berubah setelah jatuh cinta pandang pertama dengan Nurul Ain, seorang gadis kampung yang bekerja sebagai jurujual. Daniel berusaha untuk memikat Nurul Ain dengan berpura-pura menjadi seorang lelaki biasa bernama Ahmad namun akhirnya diketahui oleh Nurul Ain. Dapatkan Daniel memikat hati Nurul Ain kembali?

programme.desc: Mak Jah, seorang guru Al-Quran yang telah menabung dengan Tabung Haji selama 30 tahun demi cita-cita menunaikan haji. Namun sejak tinggal bersama anaknya, Suhaili, dia semakin risau melihat menantunya Borhan yang terlalu taksub mengejar kekayaan. programme.title: Thai Rogered Sr.11
programme.desc: Thailand expert Hu Huichong once again leads the Tom Yum Family members to introduce the latest travel information in Bangkok, including glamorous massage parlors with perfect photo spots, newly opened shopping malls with sky parks, and buffet restaurants hailed as the pinnacle of Bangkok tourism. programme.title: You Are Not Alone Again

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestantsHo Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-szeset aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various outdoor experts on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong wild women with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

programme.title: Narcotics Heroes
programme.desc: Against the backdrop of neon lights in Hong Kong, there is a hidden dark side that nobody knows - the city is the hub of narcotics from all over the world. Rewind ten years and Narcotics Bureau has apprehended Man Wah, aka Drug Lord Moses Chan. However, undercover officer Ip Ho-tin Edwin Siu is sacrificed as he is injected with a colossal dose of dope, and he has since lost his feelings. Fast-forward ten years and Man Wah suffers from cancer and is given pardon and released from prison. He seemingly lives out the rest of his life by running some upstairs bookstore. Actually, he covertly asks his old love Cheung Lam Nancy Wu and a dumb guy called Tsui On-lok Matthew Ho to engage in online drug dealing. And he uses Cheung Lams status in the financial field for money laundering in the stock market. A missing police officer case sends shock waves across Hong Kong. Ho-tin is reassigned back to Narcotics Bureau to collaborate with his ex-girlfriend Ting Yeuk-ning Kelly Cheung. A war on drugs again breaks out

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Cantopop At 50
programme.desc: Throughout the years, countless hit songs have emerged in both Chinese and international music scenes. Regardless of the era, every work has its own devoted fans. In addition to featuring influential senior artists in the music industry, the program also welcomes many singers who have not appeared in public for a long time, bringing multiple surprises to the audience.

programme.title: Hong Kong: Never Too Small
programme.desc: Amidst the ebb and flow of time, local shops that depict the microcosm of the city are becoming increasingly rare. Yet, they are a vital part of the citys structure and an irreplaceable embodiment of the Hong Kong spirit. With this in mind, the down-to-earth host, Louis Yuen, leads viewers on a shop-by-shop exploration, visiting time-honored and modern shops across four key areas of daily life: clothing, food, housing, and transportation. He reveals the shops operating history, the hardships of maintaining them, and the stories behind generations, using these tangible shops to preserve intangible memories and showcasing the enduring beauty of small spaces.

programme.title: Mystery Files
programme.desc: Love is an extremely complex subject, surrounded by numerous environmental factors that can alter our dreams and understanding of romance. These factorsranging from changes in age and the rise of internet culture to the emergence of scams and other seemingly unusual reasonshave led to bizarre, worldview-shattering love stories in society. The TVB Plus live show Mystery Files hosted by Fire Lee, Jinny Ng, and Randal Tsang, invites people from all walks of life, celebrity guests, and relationship experts to discuss each episodes theme. With unique perspectives and thought-provoking questions, they boldly explore emotional dilemmas, while also welcoming viewers to join the conversation and solve problems together through the live chatroom and call-ins.

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

Through competitions involving food preparation, puzzle challenges, photo opportunities, and historical research, the members will guide viewers to unlock hidden gems, charming shops, nostalgic establishments, and trendy landmarks throughout Macau. programme.title: The Truth Within Whats On Today
programme.desc: Episode 19 Posing as Biaozi, Han Feng conducts a deal with A-She and Mr. Meng. programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.desc: Episode 20 The handwriting in the glass factorys drug-manufacturing notes matches that of Qi Sizhes mentor, Wu Yongchang, on corrections to Qis thesis. programme.desc: Different in age, generation, and hosting style, these three hosts not only can sing, act, dance, and imitate, but are also skilled in cross-talk! With this unique combination, we hope to attract viewers of all ages and spark great entertainment.

programme.title: The Sound of Happiness
programme.desc: Wu is a senior police officer has always wanted a son to carry his family name and join the force. However, he and wife are bequeathed with four daughters! As a doting father, his chief objective is to help them find happiness in their marriages.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan dramatises folk tales, legends and local beliefs passed down through generations. Drawing on Taiwans rich cultural heritage, each story explores the lives, values and supernatural traditions of different communities.

programme.title: Detective Dee And Nine-storey Demon Building
programme.desc: A series of strange incidents happen at the Tangs demon building but Detective Dee finds no clue. Dee finds the master of the family suspicious when he speaks with him, and when the eldest daughter Miss Tang secretly informs Dee about Mr Tangs strange behavior and the fact that she is kept under surveillance, Dee vows to unveil the truth.

programme.title: Always Have Always Will
programme.desc: A struggling young man unexpectedly meets an optimistic, spirited young girl, and together they set off on an uncertain, soul-healing journey. Through lifes highs and lows, they stand by each other in hardship, their companionship mending the wounds they carry and reigniting hope in lifes darkest moments.

programme.title: The Chinese Feast
programme.desc: Sun wants to start a new life as a chef in Canada and struggles to learn cooking skills from a restaurant owner, Au. While Sun will represent his restaurant to participate in a cooking competition, his skill is not good enough, and he has to seek help from a legendary master chef in order to win the ultimate challenge.

programme.title: Wise Guys Never Die
programme.desc: Nick meets Teddy, a con artiste, when he is sent to prison for embezzlement, and Teddy teaches him all the gambling tricks. After their release, they team up with Teddys lover Lora, to take revenge on Dragon, who framed Teddy for his sentence. Nick though is seduced by Lora and they end up in an affair. Will Nick finally join Teddy in his revenge?

programme.title: Sons of the Neon Night
programme.desc: Set in a snowbound, surreal Hong Kong, a tycoon who also secretly rules the drug trade is killed in an explosion, plunging the city into chaos. With police paralysed and the family businesses in turmoil, his youngest son vows to dismantle the familys empire, but is thwarted by his fugitive brother and his fathers followers fighting for control.

programme.title: The Fierce Wife
programme.desc: An Zhen divorces her husband after his infidelity but faces a pivotal decision four years later - to return to her cheating husband and old life or to embark on a new life with a new love?

programme.title: Dust To Dust
programme.desc: Back in 1995, the Police successfully arrested five armed bank robbers while the two masterminds got tipped off and made a clean escape. Decades later, retired cop Wang Shou Yue is drawn back to the unsolved case when he sees a blurred figure in a news clip. A battle between good and evil has just begun!

programme.title: Welcome to My Side
programme.desc: After a painful breakup and a strange accident, Chen Xiao Zhou is haunted by flocks of quacking rubber ducks that only he can see. His bizarre curse disappears whenever he is with the cheerful Feng Jia Nan. As they grow closer, an absurd yet heartwarming romance blossoms, changing both their lives in unexpected ways.

programme.title: American Girl
programme.desc: 13 year-old Fen is uprooted from LA and moves to Taipei in early 2003, when her mother is diagnosed with breast cancer. She struggles to adjust to her new life with a new school and long-separated father, and drifts away from her mother. When her younger sister is misdiagnosed with SARS, they finally open up to each other during quarantine.

programme.title: Shadows Edge, The
programme.desc: A team of skilled thieves pulls off a massive billion-dollar heist while outsmarting the Sky Eye surveillance system, shocking the city. To stop the criminals before they strike again, Macau police enlist retired surveillance expert Wong Tak Chung to rebuild an elite tracking squad and hunt down the elusive mastermind behind the operation.

programme.title: Haunted Mountains: The Yellow Taboo
programme.desc: A photographer and his friends venture into a remote mountain for a photo shoot, unaware they have entered a forbidden area. As eerie incidents unfold, a mysterious boy in a yellow raincoat who leaps through the forest appears, leading them to uncover an ancient curse and terrifying secrets hidden deep within the mountain.

programme.title: The Locksmith
programme.desc: Locksmith Master Shan suffers from dementia and passes on his skills to Hao Ren, who surpasses him. Detective Liu often seeks Hao Rens help and they become good friends. When Hao Ren reunites with an old friend one day, he accidentally unfolds the truth behind Shans wifes disappearance, leading to a chain of mysterious events.

programme.title: Way We Talk, The
programme.desc: This is a soul-searching story about three youths: Wolf, Sophie and Alan, each living with a different form of deafness. Through sign language, they cultivate a profound friendship and offer each other unwavering support. United by love and friendship, the trio embarks on a journey of self-discovery and resilience.

programme.title: Bursting Point
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Bang sends Officer Ming undercover to a drug cartel to displace drug lord Yang. A failed raid triggers Yangs rage for revenge. Meanwhile, drug maker Ying Xiu is forced to cooperate with the police and sets a trap for Yang. The battle between the police and the drug cartel has just begun!

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a woman in red, leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a ghost marriage...

programme.title: Alls Well Ends Well 97
programme.desc: Mr Lo has three sons, Leung, Fay and Kung and a daughter-in-law, Eliza. While they seem like a normal family, their relationships need mending. Leung and Fay play a prank on their brother Kung on his birthday by falsely claiming that he has won the lottery. This sets off a chain reaction of funny mishaps that finally brings the family together.

programme.title: Old Fox
programme.desc: In 1989, young Liao Jie and his father save for a home, unaware of rising property prices. Frustrated by poverty, he learns from their landlord Old Fox who teaches him survival in society. Liao Jie ends up hurting Old Fox with what he has learnt, but his empathy prevents him from becoming like Old Fox.

programme.title: The White Storm 2: Drug Lords
programme.desc: Drug lord Jizo joins forces with Mexican cartels, throwing Hong Kongs drug underworld into chaos. Determined to eradicate narcotics, billionaire Yu Shun Tin offers a HK100 million bounty on drug traffickers while concealing a dark bond with Jizo. As their shared past resurfaces, an explosive showdown becomes inevitable.

programme.title: Haunted Mountains: The Yellow Taboo
programme.desc: A photographer and his friends venture into a remote mountain for a photo shoot, unaware they have entered a forbidden area. As eerie incidents unfold, a mysterious boy in a yellow raincoat who leaps through the forest appears, leading them to uncover an ancient curse and terrifying secrets hidden deep within the mountain.

programme.title: Table for Six
programme.desc: In this comedy, three brothers reside in a home inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother insists they have dinner at home every night as a family, but tensions begin to rise when their girlfriends join in as well. Love, friendship, jealousy and complicated relationships are all on the menu for this table for six!

programme.title: Everything Is Unknown
programme.desc: Pan Yi Ming receives his fathers will stating that he must attend his funeral at home to claim the huge inheritance. When he returns home, he encounters his ex-girlfriend, her husband Hua Qi and his daughter whom he has never met. When Pan discovers that his daughter is being abused by Hua, he vows to save her but eventually fall into their trap

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: Chinese immigrant Steelhead struggles to survive in Tokyo alongside fellow migrants before rising to establish a new triad. Just as he secures legal residency and decides to leave the underworld behind, a police crackdown and betrayal by his own brothers force him back into a ruthless battle for survival.

programme.title: CJ7
programme.desc: Stephen Chow returns in this hilarious and heartwarming tale of a father and son who discover an adorable alien in the trash.

programme.title: Dragon Tiger Gate
programme.desc: Adapted from a famous Hong Kong comic, Tiger Wong is ambushed after he unwittingly took the Lousha Plaque but is saved by his brother Dragon Wong. They also befriended Turbo Shek during the fight and the trio forms a brotherhood. To avenge the death of the Dragon Gate masters, they train and vow to defeat Shibumi, the leader of Lousha Clan.

programme.title: Bloody Parrot
programme.desc: A swordsman is suspected of being the thief of a treasure sent to Emperor. Through his investigation, he is led on to the trail of the supernatural Bloody Parrot. Poisonous things happen including a demonic possession, witches casting poison spells and disgusting autopsies. Then a dead constable turns into a vampire!

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiaos fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: The Water Margin
programme.desc: This is a martial arts epic directed by Chang Cheh. In the Sung Dynasty, the government is run by corrupt officials, so Sung Jiang gathers 108 outlaws at Mount Liang and establishes a band of patriotic heroes to end the repression of brutal overlords.

programme.title: Masked Avengers
programme.desc: A mysterious new gang, the Masked Avengers, is slaughtering the martial worlds greatest heroes. To stop them, three fearless fighters must track down the gangs hidden lair in Jingyang Town and put an end to their reign of terror.

programme.title: The House Of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: Roving Swordsman
programme.desc: An ambitious evil clan intends to rule the martial arts world. To achieve their goal, they must first steal a secret martial arts manuscript depicting how firearms can be produced. However, a supremely intelligent swordsman Shen Sheng Yi is protecting the manuscript and remains one step ahead of the evil clan.

programme.title: Secret Service of the Imperial Court
programme.desc: Zhao Bu Fan is the sergeant of the governments secret police. Wang is a cruel and ruthless eunuch who takes over the Emperors ruling power and leads the team of secret agents. After witnessing the atrocities committed by Eunuch Wang, Sergeant Zhao decides to defect but ends up being hunted by his friends, comrades and even his father.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The Generals henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: Apartment For Ladies
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer comes to Hong Kong in search for her missing younger sister, who had arrived in Hong Kong to be discovered as a nightclub singer. She finds lodging at an apartment for women run by a man-hating landlady, Mrs Chan. However, Mrs Chan cannot confine the young ladies youthful vitality within the apartment.

programme.title: The Magnificent Swordsman
programme.desc: The Magnificent Swordsman centres on the hero who vows vengeance against evil bandits who killed his family when he was a child. The hero recruits several friends to help the peasants rid their village of marauding bandits, the leader of the band being the man who killed his family.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: The Duel
programme.desc: After knowing his brother has killed the head of a rival triad, Jie takes the blame and was hunted by killers. With the help of Rambler Nan, Jie finally killed his enemies, but then found out that Nan is the one who has killed his father.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fte. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servants confusion, threatening the couples union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: The Killer Has No Return
programme.desc: Professional killer Lui goes to Malaysia after completing his mission of killing the big boss of a Hong Kong gang. His next target is a groom who is throwing his wedding banquet at a hotel in Chinatown. Just when Lui takes aim at his target, another victim instead of the groom is shot, and he becomes a scapegoat in this mystery assassination.

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Betty Ting plays Susan, a young woman hiding from her father by being a nightclub singer in Japan. Pop singer Chao Ke-jen Lin Chong gets permission from his boss to visit Japan, with the condition that he finds the bosss daughter. Boy finds girl, boy falls in love. But will the father approve?

programme.title: Shadow Girl
programme.desc: A young swordswoman becomes invisible during the day and a monster at night after taking her grandmas pill. She ruined the wedding of a bandit chiefs daughter using her powers and is hunted down by them for revenge. Will she escape the hunt?

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding each other and start to encounter bizarre adventures, before falling in love with each other.

programme.title: Dragon Swamp
programme.desc: Fan is cheated by her lover Tong to steal her masters Jade Dragon Sword. She is jailed in the Dragon Swamp as punishment and gave birth to a pair of twins - her daughter is raised by her master, while her son is taken by Tong. Twenty years later, the sword is stolen again and Fans daughter goes seeking for it, meeting Fans friend along the way.

programme.title: Dream of the Red Chamber1961
programme.desc: Adapted from the most widely read and filmed novel in Chinese history, this version is said to be the most successful one. Betty Lohs looks, demeanour and aura in her portrayal of Lin Dai Yu has won her the epithet Classic Beauty.

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fangs fianc and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him

programme.title: Six Assassins
programme.desc: Lord Li Ming is a feudal tyrant who oppresses the people, and even the Emperor who is his brother, cannot stop his evil act. Righteous swordsman Mu poses as Li Mings guard to plan for his assassination. He arrests six assassins who have tried to kill Li Ming, before making them his allies in a secret plot to kill him and end the tyranny.

programme.title: The Jade Faced Assassin
programme.desc: Two forbidden lovers, Zhang Zhen and Yue Nu, are killed by four villains and left behind their twin babies. Yue Nus elder sister hopes to restore the clans honour and separates the twins, arranging for them to be raised by competing clans. 18 years later, the twins meet and fight against each other, bringing chaos to the martial arts world.

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world.

programme.title: The Dragon Missile
programme.desc: Sima works for a corrupt lord Qin who is suffering from a deadly disease that only a special herb can cure. Qin sends him on an urgent mission to retrieve it, but the task is made more difficult when Sima has to fight off other martial artists who want to steal the cure away from him. He has to fight with his ultimate weapon, the Dragon Missile!

programme.title: Kurup
programme.desc: Driven by greed, Kurup weaves lies, fake deaths, and identity theft. His scheme takes a twist when a clever policeman starts pursuing him.

programme.title: Thangaraja
programme.desc: Engal Thanga Raja is about a brother who seeks revenge for the murder of his brother by pretending to be an escaped convict.

programme.title: Kanni Raasi
programme.desc: A joint family that supports only love marriages struggles to persuade their youngest member to fall in love, facing stubbornness, doubts, and heartfelt family dynamics.

programme.title: Raja Manthiri
programme.desc: Raja Manthiri is a drama genre film written and directed by Usha Krishnan and produced byP. G. Muthiah. The film stars Kalaiyarasan,Kaali Venkat,Shaalin Zoyaand Vaishali in the leading roles.

programme.title: Kennedy Club
programme.desc: Savarimuthu, an ex-soldier, falls sick while training the womens kabaddi team of his village. Soon, a former student named Muruganandham is chosen to take his place.

programme.title: Pathu Thala
programme.desc: An undercover police officer embarks on a mission to capture a crime boss and rescue a politician. However, what he discovers forces him to rethink his views on good and evil.

programme.title: Asuraguru
programme.desc: The life of a high-tech robber with exceptional skills of evading the law changes when a private detective tries to get a hold of him.

programme.title: Valimai
programme.desc: A citys crime rate rises due to a notorious motorcycle club. When chaos ensues, police officer Arjun takes charge to restore law and order.

programme.title: Kirumi
programme.desc: Kathir becomes an informant for a bad cop but realizes the error of his ways and decides to live a straight life working in his wifes garment factory.

programme.desc: Madhi helps his brother Arivu unite with the love of his life, which causes trouble between the families. When Madhi tells his parents about the woman he loves, they disapprove of his relationship.

programme.desc: Sathish and his friend, engineering college dropouts, expose the corrupt minister Devarajs illegal activities. After a students suicide, they use technology to seek revenge.
